text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: realtime-p95/p99 detector triggered — p99 latency spike on production (us-west-2) for /v1/chat.generate. Alert ID: alert-2300-99. Detection window 60s, p99=2.4s (baseline 0.6s). paging ryan_oncall :pager:
ryan_oncall: acked. I'm on it. any customers impacted yet?
maria_sre: looking at the latency dashboard now — opening quick view: https://redwood.example/dashboards/latency?range=5m :eyes:
maria_sre: p95 gone from 320ms -> 1.1s, p99 from 620ms -> 2.4s. error rate stable. traces show long tail from streaming stage (chunk assembly).
ashok_eng: tagging eng-runtime — could be KV cache misses + small batch alignment issue after the last rollout. Was a regression pushed ~30m ago?
jen_infra: pushed a small runtime patch 35m ago to tweak kernel selection on A100s in us-west-2 — rolling back now to canary 0% -> 100%? recommend 50% rollback to confirm.
ryan_oncall: try quick rollback to previous kernel profile on a small subset (canary) and see effect before full rollback. ashok, can you run a targeted test against the canary hosts?
ashok_eng: running synthetic load against canary pool (gpt-legacy-1, us-west-2). command:```siege -c 50 -t 60S 'https://api.redwood/v1/chat.generate'``` will post results in ~1m.
maria_sre: in parallel I'll check streaming infra logs. grep on stream-assembler shows repeated 'chunk-queue-delay' spikes around same window:
```
2026-03-14T11:02:12Z stream-assembler[pid=451] WARN chunk-queue-delay=810ms queue-len=42
2026-03-14T11:02:13Z stream-assembler[pid=451] WARN chunk-queue-delay=950ms queue-len=57
2026-03-14T11:02:14Z stream-assembler[pid=451] WARN chunk-queue-delay=1.1s queue-len=73
```
lucas_support: customers reporting interactive chat slowness in us-west. small # of paid customers flagged via health-check callbacks — I have customer IDs pinned in support queue (cust_42, cust_87). Not widespread yet but visible.
sophie_prod: notifying product/CS that we may need a status update if this persists >30m. tagging @ops-notify.
jen_infra: canary rollback scheduled — starting now. kubectl patch deployment runtime-profiles -n us-west-2 --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/image","value":"runtime:v1.3.2"}]'
ashok_eng: initial synthetic run complete — before rollback p99=2.3s; after killing canary and routing to v1.3.2 p99 dropped to 0.7s within two minutes. early sign looks like runtime:v1.4.0 change is culprit.
maria_sre: confirmed on dashboards: canary hosts back to v1.3.2 show p99 650ms, production pool still at 1.9s while rollback propagates.
ryan_oncall: good. escalate to eng-runtime for full rollback and postmortem. ashok, jen please coordinate full rollback timeline and mitigation plan.
ashok_eng: starting coordinated rollback to v1.3.2 across all us-west-2 runtime nodes. estimated 8-12 minutes. will monitor streaming queues.
jen_infra: rolling now. applying rollingUpdate with maxUnavailable=1 to avoid capacity drop. watch: kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime -n us-west-2
maria_sre: watching traces — streaming stalls decreasing; chunk-queue-delay samples now below 120ms after some pods rotated. progress :thumbsup:
lucas_support: starting to reply to affected customers: "we're seeing elevated latency in us-west-2, mitigation in progress, no data loss, ETA ~15m". copying support templates.
sophie_prod: agreed to keep customers informed; we'll prepare a short postmortem note once root cause confirmed.
ryan_oncall: final checks — p95 back to 300-400ms, p99 ~680ms. setting incident severity to S2 (service latency, partial customer impact). creating incident ticket INC-2300123456 and assigning to eng-runtime.
ashok_eng: action items: 1) full rollback completed, 2) run regression test harness on runtime:v1.4.0 to reproduce locally, 3) add more aggressive canary gating for kernel-selection changes, 4) postmortem with timeline + mitigation. I'll own 2+3.
maria_sre: I'll keep monitoring for 1h and follow up if any reoccurrence. adding dashboard alert threshold tweaks to reduce noisy transient triggers.
ryan_oncall: handing off to eng-runtime (ashok) for root cause & postmortem. I'll clear the page and move to watch mode. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: incident-closed-signal: automated followup scheduled in 30m to confirm stability.
